title: Oxygen delivery on display
summary_en: Biomedical researchers at WashU McKelvey Engineering have developed a new imaging technique that captures the dynamic coupling between the brain’s vasculature and its neurons. The new microscopy tool could help lead to breakthroughs in studying stroke and dementia.

title: Why are refugees with jobs still living in poverty?
summary_en: For newly resettled refugees in the United States, getting a job doesn’t always mean escaping poverty, says an expert on migration policy at Washington University in St. Louis.
title_cn: Why are refugees with jobs still living in poverty?

title: AI Perspectives Week showcases AI innovation, debate and discovery
summary_en: WashU’s AI Perspectives Week will feature about 40 events, showcasing faculty, students and leading thinkers on artificial intelligence. The series highlights research, teaching, ethics and community dialogue, while welcoming both enthusiasts and skeptics.
